svg.font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace
svg.title: Multi-tenant SaaS with a shared ML pipeline on AWS
svg.desc: Multi-tenant SaaS with a shared ML pipeline on AWS. 13 components in 10 groups. Connections: Tenant users to Amazon Cognito (sign in); Tenant users to Amazon API Gateway (requests); Amazon Cognito to Amazon API Gateway; Amazon API Gateway to Tenant router (tenant context); Tenant router to Amazon Aurora; Tenant router to Amazon Aurora; Tenant router to Amazon Aurora; Amazon Aurora to Amazon Kinesis Data Streams; Amazon Aurora to Amazon Kinesis Data Streams; Amazon Aurora to Amazon Kinesis Data Streams; Amazon Kinesis Data Streams to AWS Glue; AWS Glue to Data lake; Data lake to Training job (training data); Training job to Model registry; Model registry to Inference endpoint; Tenant router to Inference endpoint (predict).

text.tspan: MULTI-TENANT SAAS WITH A SHARED ML PIPELINE ON AWS
One control plane routes each tenant to its own Amazon Aurora database; all of them feed one shared Amazon SageMaker AI pipeline
